lines.en: Why was the girl in hospital?
lines.cn: 为什么那个女孩要住院呢？

lines.en: Nearly a week passed before
lines.cn: 差不多过了一个星期，才……

lines.en: the girl was able to explain
lines.cn: 那个女孩能够解释清楚。

lines.en: what had happened to her.
One afternoon she set out
from the coast in a small boat
lines.cn: 从海岸出发，乘坐一艘小船。

lines.en: and was caught in a storm.
lines.cn: 结果被一场暴风雨困住了。

lines.en: Towards evening,
the boat struck a rock and
the girl jumped into the sea.
Then she swam to the shore
after spending the whole night in the water.
lines.cn: 在水中度过了一整夜之后……

lines.en: During that time she covered
lines.cn: 在那段时间里，她负责报道（或记录）了相关事件。

lines.en: a distance of eight miles.
Early next morning,
she saw a light ahead.
She knew she was near the shore
lines.cn: 她知道自己已经接近海岸了。

lines.en: because the light was high up on the cliffs.
lines.cn: 因为灯光位于悬崖的高处。

lines.en: On arriving at the shore,
the girl struggled up the cliff towards
lines.cn: 那个女孩费力地爬上了悬崖，朝着……（句子未完成，后续内容缺失）

lines.en: the light she had seen.
That was all she remembered.
lines.cn: 那就是她所记得的全部内容了。

lines.en: When she woke up a day later,
she found herself in hospital.
